label: SIMULATION — live-calibrated assumptions, not a 1650 swarm measurement

live.filler_note: 0.9556 is the share of *all* kept rows (including 43 legacy) whose goal id is filler; the 2 real keeps are not filler. Do not read this as a real-goal filler rate.

cost_model.fit: T_BASE+T_MODEL+T_AFTER = 245 s matches live regression attempts (245–272 s). T_BASE+T_MODEL = 190 s is in the no_function range (180–230 s).

homogeneous.note: MLE keep rate per via (sbfl/lint/other = 0). Loc lift 0.15 when the option has a localizer.

sparse.note: Mean p matches MLE, but only a small easy subset is solvable (p_easy=0.30). Best-of-N cannot unlock the rest.

laplace.note: (k+0.5)/(n+1) prior, lint capped at test_import. Sensitivity only — not a measurement.

loc_off.note: Same as homogeneous but localizer lift is forced to 0 (SBFL stays at 0/133).

loc_strong.note: Optimistic localizer: 40% of sbfl mass inherits the test_import keep rate.

high_dup.note: Duplicate-reply share 0.40 (worse than live 0.1846). Best-of-N at T=0 collapses.

cheap_after.note: After-gate only 8 s (batch-4 planning number). Pregates and critics save almost nothing.

expensive_model.note: Each 4B call is 90 s. Extra-call options (BoN, critic, debate, MoA) get more expensive.

rows.title: Baseline (post-batch-10, flags off)
rows.verdict: post-batch-10 reference; still starves once the 95-goal pool is exhausted

rows.title: 1. Zero-model-call gem swarm
rows.verdict: ship flag-gated: no extra 4B call, can only reject or add context

rows.title: 2. Hierarchical bag-of-decisions
rows.verdict: iid lift is prefer-import (a scout rule); in a finite pool it can exhaust the solvable slice first. Hard-code interleaving in #6, do not add prompt arms

rows.title: 3a. Proposer → 4B critic (veto only)
rows.verdict: do not ship; 4B false-reject of a rare keep is too expensive

rows.title: 3b. Proposer → deterministic critic (veto only)
rows.verdict: ship as part of #1, not a separate role

rows.title: 4. Best-of-2 + deterministic prefilters
rows.fit: good fit once the queue flows
rows.verdict: second flag after #1+#6; cheap because T_MODEL << T_BASE

rows.title: 4. Best-of-4 + deterministic prefilters
rows.verdict: hold until BoN=2 is measured; +90 s per attempt

rows.title: 5. Planted-bug proposer/solver curriculum
rows.verdict: turn on when selectable=0 (already built, ETHER_PLANTED_GOALS)

rows.title: 6. Goal-flow scouts (no model calls)
rows.verdict: ship with #1; this is what ends the empty-queue outage

rows.title: 7a. Two-role debate + 4B judge (reject)
rows.verdict: reject: 3× model calls, no coverage gain, judge can kill a keep

rows.title: 7b. Mixture-of-agents, 4 proposers + aggregator (reject)
rows.verdict: reject: 5× model calls, aggregator can drop a good candidate

rows.title: 7c. Population / prompt-evolution (reject)
rows.verdict: reject: 8 arms dilutes 2 keeps; ETHER_NEURO_ES already exists and must not self-promote
